page.title: Privacy Policy
page.description: This Privacy Policy explains how Promolecules™ ("Company", "we", "our", "us") collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you visit or make a purchase from our website. We comply with GDPR and CCPA standards to keep your information safe.
page.contactNotice: For any privacy-related questions, reach us at

sections.title: 1. Who We Are
content: Registered Name: Promolecules™. We ship internationally. This policy applies to all website users and customers.

sections.title: 3. How We Use Your Data
items: Prevent fraud and comply with law
sections.note: Note: We never sell your personal data.

sections.title: 4. Cookies & Tracking
content: We use cookies and analytics tools (Google & Meta) to improve website functionality, personalize the experience, and measure performance. You can disable cookies in your browser settings anytime.

sections.title: 5. Payments & Sharing
content: Payments are securely processed by Razorpay, PayPal, or COD. We may share limited information with:
sections.notice: All partners follow strict confidentiality and data protection rules.

sections.title: 6. Data Security
items: While we take strong precautions, no online system is 100% secure.

sections.title: 7. Your Rights
content: Under GDPR & CCPA, you can request to access, correct, delete, or restrict your data. You may also withdraw consent or opt out of data sharing.

sections.title: 8. Marketing & Communications
content: By providing your contact information, you agree to receive order updates, product launches, and promotional offers. You can unsubscribe anytime.

sections.title: 9. Children's Privacy
content: Our website and products are not intended for individuals under 18. We do not knowingly collect data from minors.

sections.title: 10. Updates & Contact
content: We may update this Privacy Policy occasionally. Continued use of our site means you accept these updates.
